endpoint.recipe: documented Swift host, /v1 normalized once from API path examples

request.auth: project IAM X-Auth-Token; no S3/legacy substitution
request.mapping: Generated typed DTO fields to explicit source header/body roles; protected values reveal only when forming HTTP request. SDK-owned auth/scope cannot collide; exact source generation/kind/scope/endpoint/parent checked before credential/HTTP I/O. Binding errors pass core finalizer.
request.metadata: Set/Remove explicit headers; duplicate case-folded names or set/remove collisions rejected; protected header values no CR/LF/NUL. Explicit zero and false preserved.

variants.DeleteSegments: explicit multipart-manifest=delete cascade; no enumerated segment refs inferred

response.mapping: Generated Swift header DTO: exact Integer/Number values, protected metadata/secret temporaryURL keys, explicit scope-bound refs. No undocumented parsing of HTML control bodies; bounded discard only. Account policy usage and quotas retained. Bucket metadata/count/quota/type/version/policy fields retained.
response.acknowledgement: Success is API acknowledgement, not readiness or proof of authorship of an unknown write.

errors.raw_headers_bodies: never logged or retained in errors
errors.bounds: CallTimeout/MaxJSONBytes for structured JSON and header metadata; binary transfers use explicit TransferTimeout and caller byte bound

replay: Safe reads bounded; mutations once with retained not_sent/rejected/accepted/unknown Receipt, exact refs, no name discovery/adoption or replay
recovery: No automatic Resume or readiness waiter; existing refs identify exact caller-addressed locators, not ownership proof
limitations: Only source-documented 204 acknowledgement accepted; no unconfirmed bulk-style 200 segmented-delete response shape claimed
Current pinned Selectel subset only; whole inventory unknown, no live verification, no old Swift or generic upstream extension adoption

followup_owner.disposition: Current partial variants remain open under #61; #71 is legacy only and #74 accounts for inventory without implementing these variants. Delivery references #61; it does not close full current scope.
